title_sq: Prane Spitalit Amerikan 2, Shitet Ambient Biznesi Ne Nje Pallat Te Ri !!!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen e Dibres, prane Spitalit Amerikan 2 shitet ambient ne katin -2 me siperfaqe bruto 200 m2 te nje pallati te ri, ndertim i vitit 2022. Ambienti eshte openspace, me lartesi 3 metra, me gril te mbyllur me gjeresi 4.50 metra, me sistem sigurie 24h. Ambienti mund te shfrytezohet per magazine pasi ashtu ka funksionuar, duke patur prane dhe Tregun Industrial, por eshte i pershtatshem dhe per 5-7 poste parkimi. Ambienti disponon certifikate pronesie.
title_en: Near the American Hospital 2, Business premises for sale in a new building!!!
description_en: On Rrugen e Dibre, near American Hospital 2, premises are for sale on the -2nd floor with a gross surface area of ​​200 m2 in a new building, built in 2022. The premises are open space, 3 meters high, with a 4.50 meter wide closed grill, with a 24h security system. The environment can be used for a warehouse as it has been functioning, being close to the Industrial Market, but it is also suitable for 5-7 parking spaces. The premises have ownership certificates.
